identity.title: LER 2023-001-00 for Seabrook Station, Automatic Actuation of 'B' Emergency Diesel Generator Emergency Power Sequencer

cause.proximate_text: Spurious actuation of the EPS Remote Manual Override (RMO) relays resulted in opening of the Unit Auxiliary Transformer feeder breaker to Bus E6...most likely caused by welding activities being performed in the B Train Essential Switchgear Room. A contributing cause is age related degradation of the B EPS Power Supplies. The electrolytic capacitors were at the end of their service life making the power supplies more susceptible to conducted emissions that were introduced on ground as a result of a welding activity.
cause.theme: Spurious relay actuation induced by welding-related conducted emissions, compounded by aged power supply capacitors

notes: Cause code X ('Other') governs category per Block 13 despite narrative detailing a specific spurious-actuation/aged-capacitor mechanism; theme captures narrative nuance. B EDG was out of service for maintenance at time of event and did not start, so no EDG-related FailureMode/Consequence modeled beyond EPS actuation itself. No previous similar occurrence found per narrative (10-year review found none) so no SIMILAR_TO edge or stub LER emitted. Power supplies and RMO relays modeled as components of the JE (EPS) system per explicit narrative description; breaker-opening is a functional consequence, not containment, so no PART_OF edge from breaker to any system.
